name: enable_work_buffer_snapshot

stack.evidence: func_001D8230 takes no Script context, calls func_001116A8, and does not access or change the value stack

notes: func_001116A8 clears D_004D2998. World teardown func_001116C8 snapshots the active 0x16C00-byte work-buffer region into its backup only while this flag is zero, so command 413 enables that snapshot. It is the inverse of command 414 disable_work_buffer_snapshot. The three JP calls occur during cinematic cleanup in al02.ard, pp10.ard, and pc12.ard.
